content.title: Red Cat introduces FANG line of FPV drones
content.summary: Red Cat (RCAT) Holdings announced the launch of its FANG line of NDAA-compliant First Person View drones, starting with the 7-inch FANG F7. Initially developed through a U.S. military lab program, FANG has progressed from concept to field-ready, providing secure, retrievable FPV systems that meet federal procurement requirements. The FANG line, part of Red Cat’s Arachnid Family of Systems, provides operators with secure, American-made FPV drones that combine performance with significant savings.
